name: Middle Beach
objection: Downgraded from keep. For: OSM beach, in Commons category, surf and rock pools at low tide. Against: both counted sources only name it as the start of the Clear Place walk; no source presents it as somewhere to go, and it neighbours Lagoon Beach. Case for keeping is only the lagoon swim; I would drop it unless the owner wants township beaches.
photo_reason: Commons has only a 1024 px panoramio shot of a rocky low-tide cove (Middle Beach - panoramio) and a palm close-up; no strong photo.

name: Erscott's Hole
objection: Verified: dedicated lordhoweisland.info page (staghorn coral garden, tame fish from glass-bottom boats) and Wikivoyage (Escott's Reef, a fair swim from shore, boat advised). Pin is LOW: OSM has no feature. Only evidence is a 2019 iNaturalist file titled Erscott's Hole geotagged -31.54639,159.06083 in the lagoon; the tourism board says it sits in a protected intertidal groyne and Wikivoyage says off the airport. Accept as approximate, flagged. Comet's Hole (OSM viewpoint -31.53955,159.06642, about 1 km away) is rejected: one counted source, an offshore shark swim.
photo_reason: Commons has only fish and shark close-ups (Carcharhinus galapagensis erscotts hole.jpg, Greyhead Surgeonfish) which fail check 3. Search outside Commons (tourism board, glass-bottom boat operators).
